Subject: Re: Capacity constraint war room — quick technical notes

A few quick notes to seed the discussion before Tue:
- For scoring-heavy workloads with long contexts we recommend baseline reserved capacity equal to 1.5x the 95th-percentile concurrent sessions to absorb bursts.
- Safe burst: implement soft QoS via request prioritization + token-rate limiting; hard node pinning only for regulatory isolation (adds cold-start risk).
- Autoscale window: 30s aggregation + progressive scale-up (up to 3x within 5m) helps keep latency SLOs while avoiding oscillation.
- KV cache warming: for expected retrain jobs, schedule pre-warm jobs during off-peak to avoid cold-KV penalties.

I'll put a 3-slide deck together with numbers and tail-latency curves — will upload to the shared doc by EOD.

—Rishi
